issue_context.title: Add an EVP signature demo using DSA
issue_context.body:
Use a named group.  Do both validation and signature generation.

It should be the current best practice (fetch), have proper error handling and resource allocation/deallocation and be in the style of a known answer test.

review_comments: check for null here also. If this failed it would fallback to using the default libctx
A comment that this is calculating the signature size might be good.
